summary: Assign nested Docker build paths to infrastructure

delivery.outcome: Nested Docker build declarations consumed by Koru have narrow, explicit workstream ownership before their supply-chain inputs are changed.
nonGoals: Modify Dockerfiles, Compose services or application tests
Change dependency manifests or runtime behavior
Change ownership of existing application, integration, governance or interface paths
Close issue #64 before the owned implementation tickets merge

architecture.decision: Complete coordination classification for previously unowned Docker build declarations without moving any runtime component or existing workstream responsibility; leave tests/docker under application ownership.
architecture.rollback: Revert the protected ticket merge; no Docker runtime declaration changes in this ticket.
